_comment: 1화 「안녕, 나는 쿵쿵이야!」 컷 리스트 — 2차 개정 대본(docs/05) 기준. {이름}은 전체 묘사, [이름]은 축약 묘사, characters에 없는 이름은 fragments로 치환된다. speaker가 '나레이션'이면 화면 밖 목소리라 립싱크가 필요 없고, 캐릭터 이름이면 립싱크 대상이다. 영상은 MiniMax H3(OpenArt 웹, 무제한)로 만들고, 키프레임은 MCP로 생성한다. 이전 shots.json(128컷)은 1차 대본 기준이라 무효다.

sections.SC1: Act 1 · SC#1 남극의 밤 — 유성 낙하와 얼음 속 알
sections.SC2: Act 1 · SC#2 숲속 강가 — 얼음 알 발견
sections.SC3: Act 2 · SC#3 강가 공터 새벽 — 부화, 첫 파워, 이름
sections.SC4: Act 3 · SC#4 불어난 개울가 — 루비 구조
sections.EN: 엔딩 · 따뜻한 첫 만남 + 유성 복선

shots.speaker: 나레이션
shots.ko: 밤의 남극. 끝없는 푸른 얼음 절벽과 검은 바다, 하늘 전체를 덮은 은녹색 오로라. 아무도 없는 거대한 설원의 첫 장면.
shots.ko_motion: 오로라가 천천히 물결치고 눈가루가 얼음 위를 흐른다. 카메라가 아주 느리게 앞으로 밀고 들어간다.
shots.image_ref: 3D Pixar/DreamWorks style animated film still, high detail fur and scale texture, cinematic lighting, family animation movie quality, 16:9 cinematic composition, a vast frozen wasteland at night, endless blue-white ice cliffs meeting a black sea, a silver-green aurora rippling across the whole sky, utterly still and immense, epic wide establishing shot
shots.image: a vast frozen wasteland at night, endless blue-white ice cliffs meeting a black sea, a silver-green aurora rippling across the whole sky, utterly still and immense, epic wide establishing shot
shots.motion: The aurora ripples slowly across the sky, fine snow drifting over the ice, camera creeping forward

shots.ko: 그 오로라 하늘을 유성 하나가 가르며 떨어진다. 황금빛 청록 불꽃 꼬리를 끌고, 아래 얼음판이 그 빛에 환해진다.
shots.ko_motion: 유성이 불꽃을 흩뿌리며 하늘을 찢고 지나가고, 그 빛이 얼음 위를 훑고 간다.
shots.image_ref: 3D Pixar/DreamWorks style animated film still, high detail fur and scale texture, cinematic lighting, family animation movie quality, 16:9 cinematic composition, the aurora sky above the frozen land suddenly split by a brilliant meteor streaking down, trailing golden-teal fire and sparks, the ice below lit up by its glow
shots.image: the aurora sky above the frozen land suddenly split by a brilliant meteor streaking down, trailing golden-teal fire and sparks, the ice below lit up by its glow
shots.motion: The meteor tears across the sky trailing sparks, its light sweeping over the ice below

shots.ko: 떨어지는 유성의 핵을 초근접으로. 황금빛 청록으로 타오르며 빛나는 파편들이 떨어져 나간다.
shots.ko_motion: 유성 핵이 회전하며 파편이 카메라 옆으로 스쳐 흐르고, 빛은 점점 강해진다.
shots.image_ref: 3D Pixar/DreamWorks style animated film still, high detail fur and scale texture, cinematic lighting, family animation movie quality, 16:9 cinematic composition, extreme close-up of the meteor core burning golden-teal as it falls, jagged glowing fragments breaking away, sparks streaming past camera
shots.image: extreme close-up of the meteor core burning golden-teal as it falls, jagged glowing fragments breaking away, sparks streaming past camera
shots.motion: The meteor core tumbles as fragments break away and stream past camera, glowing brighter

shots.speaker: 나레이션
shots.dialogue: 하늘에서 떨어진 신비한 유성 빛을 머금고
shots.ko: 유성이 빙판에 충돌. 황금빛 청록 충격파가 눈부시게 사방으로 퍼지고 얼음 조각과 눈이 공중으로 솟는다.
shots.ko_motion: 충돌과 동시에 빛의 고리가 얼음 위로 터져 나가고, 하늘의 오로라도 함께 크게 일렁인다.
shots.image_ref: 3D Pixar/DreamWorks style animated film still, high detail fur and scale texture, cinematic lighting, family animation movie quality, 16:9 cinematic composition, the meteor striking the ice sheet, a blinding golden-teal shockwave blasting outward across the frozen plain, ice shards and snow thrown into the air, dramatic impact
shots.image: the meteor striking the ice sheet, a blinding golden-teal shockwave blasting outward across the frozen plain, ice shards and snow thrown into the air, dramatic impact
shots.motion: The meteor hits and a ring of light blasts outward across the ice, snow and shards flying, the aurora flaring in response

shots.ko: 얼음에 파인 거대한 크레이터. 바닥에 흩어진 유성 파편들이 김을 피우며 빛나고, 그 빛이 주변 얼음벽으로 스며든다.
shots.ko_motion: 파편에서 김이 피어오르고 크레이터 벽을 따라 빛이 은은하게 맥동한다.
shots.image_ref: 3D Pixar/DreamWorks style animated film still, high detail fur and scale texture, cinematic lighting, family animation movie quality, 16:9 cinematic composition, a huge crater carved into the ice, glowing meteor fragments scattered across its floor giving off wisps of steam, golden-teal light seeping through the surrounding ice walls
shots.image: a huge crater carved into the ice, glowing meteor fragments scattered across its floor giving off wisps of steam, golden-teal light seeping through the surrounding ice walls
shots.motion: Steam curls up from the glowing fragments, light pulsing softly through the crater walls

shots.ko: 크레이터 벽의 투명한 푸른 얼음 속에 박힌 거대한 알. 오로라 빛이 얼음을 타고 흘러 껍질에 스며든다.
shots.ko_motion: 황금빛 청록 파장이 얼음을 통과해 알로 스며들고, 껍질이 서서히 밝아진다.
shots.image_ref: 3D Pixar/DreamWorks style animated film still, high detail fur and scale texture, cinematic lighting, family animation movie quality, 16:9 cinematic composition, a colossal pale egg embedded deep in the translucent blue ice of the crater wall, golden-teal aurora light flowing through the ice and soaking into its shell
shots.image: a colossal pale egg embedded deep in the translucent blue ice of the crater wall, golden-teal aurora light flowing through the ice and soaking into its shell
shots.motion: Waves of golden-teal light travel through the ice and sink into the egg, the shell slowly brightening

shots.speaker: 나레이션
shots.dialogue: 하나의 거대한 알이 숨을 쉬기 시작했어요.
shots.ko: 알 표면 초근접. 껍질 안쪽에서 빛이 새어 나오고, 심장박동처럼 느린 빛의 결이 퍼진다.
shots.ko_motion: 알 속 빛이 한 번, 다시 한 번 — 더 느리고 더 강하게 맥동한다. 첫 숨 같은 느낌.
shots.image_ref: 3D Pixar/DreamWorks style animated film still, high detail fur and scale texture, cinematic lighting, family animation movie quality, 16:9 cinematic composition, extreme close-up of the egg's surface glowing from within, faint veins of golden-teal light spreading across the shell like a slow heartbeat
shots.image: extreme close-up of the egg's surface glowing from within, faint veins of golden-teal light spreading across the shell like a slow heartbeat
shots.motion: The light inside the egg pulses once, then again, slower and stronger, like a first breath

shots.ko: 오로라 아래 얼음 크레이터를 아주 높은 곳에서 내려다본 그림. 광대한 설원 속 따뜻한 빛 한 점.
shots.ko_motion: 카메라가 상승하며 뒤로 빠지고, 알의 빛이 오로라 아래 작은 점 하나로 줄어든다.
shots.image_ref: 3D Pixar/DreamWorks style animated film still, high detail fur and scale texture, cinematic lighting, family animation movie quality, 16:9 cinematic composition, the ice crater seen from high above at night under the aurora, a single point of warm light glowing deep in the ice, tiny against the enormous frozen land
shots.image: the ice crater seen from high above at night under the aurora, a single point of warm light glowing deep in the ice, tiny against the enormous frozen land
shots.motion: Camera rises and pulls back over the frozen land, the egg's glow shrinking to a single warm point beneath the aurora

shots.speaker: 나레이션
shots.ko: 폭풍우가 지나간 다음 날 아침의 숲속 강가. 젖은 잎과 물웅덩이가 햇빛에 반짝이고, 강물은 불어 흙탕이며 부러진 가지가 널려 있다.
shots.ko_motion: 구름 사이로 햇살이 들어오고, 잎에서 물방울이 떨어지며 불어난 강이 세차게 흐른다.
shots.image_ref: 3D Pixar/DreamWorks style animated film still, high detail fur and scale texture, cinematic lighting, family animation movie quality, 16:9 cinematic composition, a lush green forest riverbank the morning after a storm, wet leaves and puddles glittering in fresh sunlight, the river running high and brown, torn branches on the banks
shots.image: a lush green forest riverbank the morning after a storm, wet leaves and puddles glittering in fresh sunlight, the river running high and brown, torn branches on the banks
shots.motion: Sunlight breaks through drifting clouds over the wet forest, water dripping from leaves, the swollen river rushing past

shots.ko: 루카·후안·루비·미미·티니 다섯 친구가 나무 사이에서 햇빛 드는 강가로 함께 걸어 나온다. 밝은 아침 분위기.
shots.ko_motion: 다섯이 물웅덩이를 첨벙이며 숲에서 나와 폭풍이 남긴 자리를 둘러본다.
shots.image_ref: 3D Pixar/DreamWorks style animated film still, high detail fur and scale texture, cinematic lighting, family animation movie quality, 16:9 cinematic composition, Luca the tiger cub, Juan the penguin, Ruby the rabbit, Mimi the koala and Tini the puppy walking out of the treeline onto the sunlit riverbank together, splashing through puddles, cheerful morning mood. Use the attached reference sheets for every character in this shot: keep each character's face, head shape, proportions, colors, markings and outfit exactly as shown in the reference. Do not redesign, restyle or age the characters.
shots.image: [루카], [후안], [루비], [미미] and [티니] walking out of the treeline onto the sunlit riverbank together, splashing through puddles, cheerful morning mood
shots.motion: The five friends come out of the trees splashing through puddles, looking around at the storm damage

shots.ko: 티니가 코를 땅에 대고 강가를 앞서 달린다. 꼬리를 세차게 흔들며 떠내려온 잔해를 킁킁댄다.
shots.ko_motion: 강아지가 냄새를 맡으며 앞서 뛰다가 갑자기 멈춰 고개를 번쩍 든다.
shots.image_ref: 3D Pixar/DreamWorks style animated film still, high detail fur and scale texture, cinematic lighting, family animation movie quality, 16:9 cinematic composition, Tini the puppy bounding ahead along the riverbank with his nose to the ground, tail wagging hard, sniffing at the debris. Use the attached reference sheets for every character in this shot: keep each character's face, head shape, proportions, colors, markings and outfit exactly as shown in the reference. Do not redesign, restyle or age the characters.
shots.image: [티니] bounding ahead along the riverbank with his nose to the ground, tail wagging hard, sniffing at the debris
shots.motion: The puppy bounds ahead sniffing the ground, tail whipping, then freezes and lifts his head sharply

shots.speaker: 나레이션
shots.dialogue: 강가로 나온 친구들의 눈 앞에 신기한 광경이 펼쳐졌답니다.
shots.ko: 강가 바위에 걸린 거대한 얼음덩어리. 햇빛이 관통하고 그 안쪽 깊은 곳에 창백하고 거대한 무언가가 비친다. 친구들은 그 옆에서 아주 작다.
shots.ko_motion: 카메라가 친구들을 지나 얼음덩어리로 밀고 들어간다. 햇빛이 얼음에 굴절되고 물이 밑둥을 감아 흐른다.
shots.image_ref: 3D Pixar/DreamWorks style animated film still, high detail fur and scale texture, cinematic lighting, family animation movie quality, 16:9 cinematic composition, a huge block of ice lodged against the rocks at the river's edge, sunlight blazing through it, something enormous and pale visible deep inside, the friends small beside it. Use the attached reference sheets for every character in this shot: keep each character's face, head shape, proportions, colors, markings and outfit exactly as shown in the reference. Do not redesign, restyle or age the characters.
shots.image: a huge block of ice lodged against the rocks at the river's edge, sunlight blazing through it, something enormous and pale visible deep inside, the friends small beside it
shots.motion: Camera pushes in past the friends toward the ice block, sunlight refracting through it, water rushing around its base

shots.ko: 다섯 친구가 그 자리에 굳어 얼음덩어리를 올려다본다. 입이 벌어져 있고, 루카가 팔을 뻗어 나머지를 뒤로 막는다.
shots.ko_motion: 친구들이 급히 멈춰 서서 위를 올려다보고, 루카가 팔을 뻗어 친구들을 막는다.
shots.image_ref: 3D Pixar/DreamWorks style animated film still, high detail fur and scale texture, cinematic lighting, family animation movie quality, 16:9 cinematic composition, the five friends from the reference sheets stopping dead and staring up at the ice block, mouths open, Luca the tiger cub holding out an arm to keep the others back. Use the attached reference sheets for every character in this shot: keep each character's face, head shape, proportions, colors, markings and outfit exactly as shown in the reference. Do not redesign, restyle or age the characters.
shots.image: the five friends stopping dead and staring up at the ice block, mouths open, [루카] holding out an arm to keep the others back
shots.motion: The friends stop short and stare upward, [루카] flinging out an arm to hold them back

shots.speaker: 루카
shots.dialogue: 우와! 이것 좀 봐! 얼음 안에 진짜 커다란 알이 있어!
shots.ko: 루카 클로즈업. 비행 고글을 눈까지 내려 쓰고 얼음 쪽으로 몸을 기울인다. 신나고 놀란 얼굴.
shots.ko_motion: 호랑이가 고글을 확 끌어내려 쓰고 얼음에 바짝 붙으며 눈이 커진다.
shots.image_ref: 3D Pixar/DreamWorks style animated film still, high detail fur and scale texture, cinematic lighting, family animation movie quality, 16:9 cinematic composition, close-up of Luca the tiger cub pulling his aviator goggles down over his eyes and leaning in toward the ice, thrilled and amazed. Use the attached reference sheets for every character in this shot: keep each character's face, head shape, proportions, colors, markings and outfit exactly as shown in the reference. Do not redesign, restyle or age the characters.
shots.image: close-up of [루카] pulling his aviator goggles down over his eyes and leaning in toward the ice, thrilled and amazed
shots.motion: The tiger cub yanks his goggles down over his eyes and presses close to the ice, eyes going wide

shots.ko: 햇빛 든 얼음 너머로 드러나는 거대한 알의 곡면. 그 안에서 오로라 빛이 아직 희미하게 움직인다.
shots.ko_motion: 카메라가 맑아지는 얼음을 통과하며 알의 형태가 드러나고, 청록 빛이 표면을 느리게 훑고 지나간다.
shots.image_ref: 3D Pixar/DreamWorks style animated film still, high detail fur and scale texture, cinematic lighting, family animation movie quality, 16:9 cinematic composition, extreme close-up through the sunlit ice revealing the curved surface of the enormous pale egg, shimmering golden-teal aurora light still faintly moving within it
shots.image: extreme close-up through the sunlit ice revealing the curved surface of the enormous pale egg, {오로라빛} still faintly moving within it
shots.motion: The camera drifts through the clearing ice as the egg's shape resolves, a slow ripple of teal light crossing its surface

shots.speaker: 미미
shots.dialogue: 이상해... 얼음 속에서 따뜻한 오로라 빛이 흘러나오고 있어.
shots.ko: 미미가 동그란 안경을 고쳐 쓰며 얼음을 가까이 관찰한다. 청록 빛이 안경알에 비친다. 사려 깊고 매료된 표정.
shots.ko_motion: 코알라가 안경을 올려 쓰고 몸을 기울이자 청록 빛이 렌즈 위를 지나간다.
shots.image_ref: 3D Pixar/DreamWorks style animated film still, high detail fur and scale texture, cinematic lighting, family animation movie quality, 16:9 cinematic composition, Mimi the koala adjusting her round glasses as she studies the ice closely, the teal glow reflecting in her lenses, thoughtful and fascinated. Use the attached reference sheets for every character in this shot: keep each character's face, head shape, proportions, colors, markings and outfit exactly as shown in the reference. Do not redesign, restyle or age the characters.
shots.image: [미미] adjusting her round glasses as she studies the ice closely, the teal glow reflecting in her lenses, thoughtful and fascinated
shots.motion: The koala pushes her glasses up and leans in, the teal glow moving across her lenses as she studies it

shots.ko: 후안이 뒤뚱뒤뚱 얼음까지 걸어가 두 날개와 뺨을 붙였다가 차가움에 움찔 물러선다.
shots.ko_motion: 펭귄이 얼음에 몸을 붙였다가 부르르 떨며 뒤로 물러나 몸을 턴다.
shots.image_ref: 3D Pixar/DreamWorks style animated film still, high detail fur and scale texture, cinematic lighting, family animation movie quality, 16:9 cinematic composition, Juan the penguin waddling right up to the ice and pressing both flippers and his cheek against it, then flinching back from the cold. Use the attached reference sheets for every character in this shot: keep each character's face, head shape, proportions, colors, markings and outfit exactly as shown in the reference. Do not redesign, restyle or age the characters.
shots.image: [후안] waddling right up to the ice and pressing both flippers and his cheek against it, then flinching back from the cold
shots.motion: The penguin presses his flippers and cheek to the ice, then jerks back with a shiver and shakes himself

shots.speaker: 루비
shots.dialogue: 알이 추워 보여. 우리가 꼭 안아줘서 녹여주자!
shots.ko: 루비가 얼음에 두 앞발을 대고 서 있다. 별 지팡이는 겨드랑이에 끼고, 얼굴엔 따뜻한 걱정이 어려 있다.
shots.ko_motion: 토끼가 두 발을 얼음에 대고 친구들 쪽으로 돌아보며 다정하고 단호한 표정을 짓는다.
shots.image_ref: 3D Pixar/DreamWorks style animated film still, high detail fur and scale texture, cinematic lighting, family animation movie quality, 16:9 cinematic composition, Ruby the rabbit standing close to the ice with both paws pressed against it, her star wand tucked under one arm, warm concern on her face. Use the attached reference sheets for every character in this shot: keep each character's face, head shape, proportions, colors, markings and outfit exactly as shown in the reference. Do not redesign, restyle or age the characters.
shots.image: [루비] standing close to the ice with both paws pressed against it, her star wand tucked under one arm, warm concern on her face
shots.motion: The rabbit presses both paws to the ice and turns to the others with a determined, gentle look

shots.ko: 얼음덩어리를 둘러싼 다섯 친구가 서로를 바라본다. 한 명씩 고개를 끄덕이며 마음이 정해진다.
shots.ko_motion: 친구들이 서로 눈빛을 주고받고 차례로 고개를 끄덕이며 각오를 다진다.
shots.image_ref: 3D Pixar/DreamWorks style animated film still, high detail fur and scale texture, cinematic lighting, family animation movie quality, 16:9 cinematic composition, the five friends from the reference sheets looking at each other around the ice block, nodding one by one, a decision passing between them. Use the attached reference sheets for every character in this shot: keep each character's face, head shape, proportions, colors, markings and outfit exactly as shown in the reference. Do not redesign, restyle or age the characters.
shots.image: the five friends looking at each other around the ice block, nodding one by one, a decision passing between them
shots.motion: The friends exchange looks around the circle, each nodding in turn, resolve building

shots.ko: 다섯 친구가 사방에서 거대한 얼음덩어리에 몸을 붙이고 팔과 날개를 활짝 펴 껴안는다. 등에 아침 햇살이 따뜻하다.
shots.ko_motion: 친구들이 동시에 다가가 사방에서 얼음을 꼭 끌어안는다.
shots.image_ref: 3D Pixar/DreamWorks style animated film still, high detail fur and scale texture, cinematic lighting, family animation movie quality, 16:9 cinematic composition, the five friends from the reference sheets moving in and pressing themselves against the huge ice block from every side, arms and flippers spread wide across it, sunlight warm on their backs. Use the attached reference sheets for every character in this shot: keep each character's face, head shape, proportions, colors, markings and outfit exactly as shown in the reference. Do not redesign, restyle or age the characters.
shots.image: the five friends moving in and pressing themselves against the huge ice block from every side, arms and flippers spread wide across it, sunlight warm on their backs
shots.motion: The friends step in together and wrap themselves against the ice from all sides, hugging it tight

shots.ko: 밤의 강가. 작아진 얼음덩어리를 둥글게 둘러싸고 다섯 친구가 잠들어 있다. 달빛과 옅은 안개, 평온하고 뭉클한 그림.
shots.ko_motion: 잠든 친구들의 숨이 함께 오르내리고 안개가 흐르며 얼음에서 녹은 물이 똑똑 떨어진다.
shots.image_ref: 3D Pixar/DreamWorks style animated film still, high detail fur and scale texture, cinematic lighting, family animation movie quality, 16:9 cinematic composition, the riverbank at night, the five friends from the reference sheets curled asleep in a ring around the shrinking ice block, moonlight and drifting mist, peaceful and tender. Use the attached reference sheets for every character in this shot: keep each character's face, head shape, proportions, colors, markings and outfit exactly as shown in the reference. Do not redesign, restyle or age the characters.
shots.image: the riverbank at night, the five friends curled asleep in a ring around the shrinking ice block, moonlight and drifting mist, peaceful and tender
